title: Read the Pattern in Pieces
text: The pattern looks for one or more digits, exactly one space, then one or more non-space characters. It also requires an exclamation mark after that text.

title: Captured Text Before the Final Exclamation Mark
text: In the substring $$3$$ times!!!, what does the capturing group return when the final ! is matched outside the group?

title: Remember What the Capturing Group Returns
text: Because the parentheses do not include the final ! after the group, that last exclamation mark is required for the match but is not returned by re.findall.

title: Check Why $$\frac{10}{10}$$ Is Not Returned
text: The 10/10! text does not match the pattern because after the digits $$10$$, the next character is / instead of the required single space.
